band_structure_study.headline: MEASURED 2026-09-16: NO SIGNAL SEPARATES (no lift larger than 2.80pp) — ordered by ceiling thickness, floor layering as the tiebreak
band_structure_study.body: Measured on 24,994 episodes in 2025-03-10 -> 2026-08-17, 3,716 names, broad. Neither a thin first lid nor a layered floor survived the rule of reading on all three out-of-sample splits, so there is no score and the board says so. reversal episodes only (first per symbol + 20-bar cooldown); bands on CLOSED bars strictly before the print with the board geometry; no costs; one regime 2025-03-10 -> 2026-08-17; every thinness claim was read INSIDE the 2026-09-07 lid-break DISTANCE buckets ≤5%, 5–15%, >15%, which is the study that already found DISTANCE decides — and the only two reads that move here are that same distance (lid_dist_pct +9.35pp, sup1_dist_pct +9.13pp), not structure; survivorship replayed on the cache universe (5,284 names / 37,426 episodes): 32.73% reach +5% before the floor against 34.20% broad, -1.46pp, so no survivorship bias is carrying this null. Re-runnable verbatim: backend/scripts/band_structure_study.py.
band_structure_study.fallback_note: Ordered by his two asks, in the order he asked them: the ceiling first, then the floor as the tiebreak — a second band closest under the first, then the bigger first band. The ceiling leg has THREE groups, not one scale: a name with nothing PROVEN overhead is UNTESTED rather than thin (fewer than 2 touches up there, so the wall is uncounted, not absent — the stat says which untested band is nearest and whether the print is standing in it), then the names whose first wall can actually be measured, thinnest first, then the ones whose ceiling cannot be read at all. WHICH END THE UNTESTED GROUP BELONGS ON IS AN OPEN QUESTION — it leads today because that is what shipped, and nobody has measured it either way. All of this is a DESCRIPTIVE ordering of what the bands look like, not a claim that a thin ceiling or a layered floor makes a name go up. Because it is lexicographic the ceiling settles nearly every pair and the floor only breaks ties. A name with no band read sorts last, never first.
band_structure_study.limits: Bands are BOARD geometry on CLOSED bars — the live session's own high and low are not in them, and an unproven lid (fewer than 2 touches) is not counted overhead at all, here or anywhere else. A band the engine did not cluster is not a band that is not there. Ordered on the tiles this page is showing: the read keys on the LIVE print, which only exists after the board has been cut to its page size, so this ranks the page rather than the whole universe behind it. This is a board ordering and a stat — it gates no alert, sizes no position and enters no lane.
